exposure: body composition at term equivalent age
body composition in the first 3 months of life
gain in fat-free mass between term and 3 months
outcome: fat-free mass at 4 to 7 years of life
fat mass percentage at 4 to 7 years of life
cohort: The study included children born under 32-week gestational age or less than 1500g.
finding: Early body composition, specifically fat mass percentage and fat-free mass at term, and fat-free mass and its gain in the first 3 months, is associated with fat-free mass at preschool age (4-7 years).
